proposedAppendOnlyControls.title: captures the complete owned inventory despite explicitly unknown unrelated process metadata
proposedAppendOnlyControls.input: Unchanged observer/root/Chrome/ffmpeg/transient graph and commands plus one valid unique unrelated PID with PPID1. In the same bounded test, supply unrelated unknown state, empty command, and C0-bearing command suffix as three explicit metadata variants.
proposedAppendOnlyControls.postcondition: Exact successful expected owned tree with every original descendant and genuine binary label; no error. The unrelated numeric row remains in the supplied graph, never skipped.
proposedAppendOnlyControls.oldExpectedFailure: Existing global metadata validation prevents the successful coherent-owned-capture postcondition.
proposedAppendOnlyControls.newExpected: Successful postcondition under required-population metadata validation.

proposedAppendOnlyControls.title: rejects unknown metadata on observer root and every owned descendant
proposedAppendOnlyControls.input: Place the same explicit UNKNOWN metadata payload in turn on observer self, actual child root and a reachable transient descendant; numeric graph remains valid and complete.
proposedAppendOnlyControls.postcondition: Each required-population corruption fails closed. No metadata placeholder or row filtering returns a tree. Existing graph/read/root/liveness tests remain unchanged.

proposedAppendOnlyControls.title: confirms the exact original stopped inventory despite unrelated unknown metadata
proposedAppendOnlyControls.input: Capture the valid original tree, then present the same full graph with all original descendants known stopped/live, strict fake signal0 ALIVE, and one unrelated valid-identity UNKNOWN-metadata row.
proposedAppendOnlyControls.postcondition: One fresh confirmation returns exactly the original observed set, preserving order; no PID substitution, omitted probe, per-PID command query or extra ps read.

proposedAppendOnlyControls.title: requires strict metadata for original members after reparenting during confirmation
proposedAppendOnlyControls.input: Capture valid original tree; reparent the original transient PID to PID1 in the next coherent snapshot. With its original known binary and stopped/live state, strict signal0 ALIVE confirms the full original set. Change only that original member metadata to UNKNOWN, then separately add a new currently reachable descendant with UNKNOWN metadata.
proposedAppendOnlyControls.postcondition: Valid reparenting retains and confirms the original member. Unknown metadata of either the reparented original member or a currently reachable descendant fails closed; original inventory remains frozen and unchanged.
